customer_name: China Longyuan Power Group Corporation Ltd. (龙源电力)
business_problem: Longyuan Power needed a scalable way to monitor far-flung wind farms and turbines, identify safety and equipment risks faster, and turn production data into a more centralized, intelligent operating model for renewable-energy assets.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud helped Longyuan Power build a production-operations intelligent platform for renewable generation by layering AI video recognition on top of its national wind-power footprint. The system uses a three-level management architecture spanning headquarters, provincial monitoring centers, and individual new-energy sites, then adds two classes of intelligent algorithms: personnel-safety recognition and equipment-status recognition. Video feeds and operational data from more than twelve thousand turbines and over two hundred wind farms are centralized so remote staff can identify hazards, monitor field operations, and respond faster without constant on-site presence. The platform also serves as the base for more advanced applications such as AR-assisted remote maintenance, digital-twin plants, predictive turbine maintenance, generation forecasting, and coordinated dispatch across wind, solar, and storage. Instead of running isolated site-level tools, Longyuan now operates a cloud-intelligent foundation for inspection, control, and renewable-asset scaling.

solution_components.name: Production Operations Intelligent Platform
solution_components.role: Centralizes renewable-asset monitoring and provides the base operating environment for Longyuan's digital production workflows.

solution_components.name: Video Intelligent Recognition System
solution_components.role: Processes site video feeds so inspection and safety events can be detected automatically across wind farms.

solution_components.name: Personnel Safety Recognition Algorithms
solution_components.role: Detect unsafe personnel behavior and help site teams identify and report hazards quickly.

solution_components.name: Equipment Status Recognition Algorithms
solution_components.role: Spot asset-state anomalies and support intelligent inspection and maintenance decisions for renewable equipment.

data_flow: Video streams and production data from wind farms and turbines are collected into Longyuan's centralized platform, where recognition algorithms analyze personnel safety conditions and equipment status. Alerts and inspection results are then surfaced to headquarters and provincial monitoring centers so staff can respond quickly and coordinate field action across sites.
business_outcome: Longyuan achieved more centralized oversight of renewable assets, reduced inspection risk, improved response speed, and established an intelligent operating base for future digital-twin, predictive-maintenance, and dispatch-optimization scenarios.
metrics: The platform helps manage more than 12,000 turbines across more than 200 wind farms.
architecture_clues: The operating model spans headquarters, provincial centers, and wind-farm sites in a three-level architecture.
The current AI inspection base is intended to expand into AR remote maintenance, digital twins, predictive maintenance, generation forecasting, and coordinated dispatch.
Safety and equipment-status recognition run on top of the customer's existing video-monitoring footprint.
